_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it). Read by scripts/setup-env.sh (fail-closed sha256 check). Shape follows 2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap sim/pdk.json (read at b16eb968473856b26185b05fbb49146731b8ad13); same release, no deviation.

osdi_toolchain._comment: sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is the executable source of truth for these pins; this block restates them. No .osdi binary is committed: they are platform-specific and are compiled from the PDK's own Verilog-A sources. The HBT (VBIC) model is built into ngspice and needs no OSDI.
